events.text: The 38 class briefly returned to the former Melbourne Limited Express route.

events.text: 3830 and 3813 hauled the inaugural standard gauge Spirit of Progress from Albury to Sydney.

events.text: The first 38 class locomotive was withdrawn.

events.text: 3801 hauled the Western Endeavour to Perth.
